text.text_excerpt: Ummmmm, in my Big Freedia voice... YOU ALREADY KNOW!!!! I'm here for it. A BOOZY SNOBALL... refreshing & intoxicating, literally!!!! Read this place was opening, June 13, and I had to get out & SUPPORT... and get me a Boozy-ball, Boozy-Snoball or whatever you want to call it, I needed it!!!! Great customer service... premium product (I was on my level after about 4 SIPS! I added an extra shot, just to make sure it was a good combo of booze & Snoball flavor... and that was a PERFECT thing to do... I was litty!!!! Hello + Goodbye at the same doggone time!!! Mango + Henny for ya girl please... There's also a food menu with all kids of lite bites, but I came SPECIFICALLY for the SnoBall & I g...

Thanks y'all Nolasips I had a blast picking out my flavor (Strawberry Lemonade and then topping Cotton Candy then throw on the spirits I chose Top Shelf Vodka). I can't believe they had D'usse with the cognac shortage. The turkey burger sliders were rolling and the honey heat wings were delicious. Wednesdays are $1 wing Wednesdays. I had to give 4 stars because it was a little hot in there. It's hot in New Orleans in the summer.

I just love absolutely everything about this place. If you follow the owner on Instagram you got to see her build this place from the ground up. All her DIY decorations on the chairs and the lights and the walls give it such a cool, funky vibe. From the second you walk in, they have the music playing and the employees behind the counter slingin snowballs are dancing. It's just such a fun place. You might be waiting in line for a little while because it's not super fast, understandably because designer snowballs are a craft and what you're served at the end is definitely a work of art.
